Thinkbyte: Harsha Thota, Raghu Gorrela
Awcsellers
Key Takeaways
Abhishek stressed the need for clear communication and a documented strategy to avoid past issues and manage high lead acquisition costs.
Agreement reached on creating targeted reels and combining SEO with paid marketing to increase campaign effectiveness.
Action items set to finalize webinar details, create a content calendar, and evaluate campaign impact for future budgeting.
Next steps include finalizing the social media management proposal and discussing pilot webinar costs at the upcoming meeting.
Action Items
Raghu Gorrela
Check with Harshal regarding the lead cost for the campaign.
Both
Work on the community aspect and create a WhatsApp group.
Follow-up on the commercial agreement and discuss further details in the next meeting.
Discuss adding a cost for the pilot webinar.
Prospect
Work on creating reels for social media.
Integrate SEO with paid marketing strategies in the long-term plan.
Provide Pavan's contact information.
Rep
Measure campaign effectiveness and ROI after the webinar.
Provide feedback on setting up a well-documented plan for the upcoming weeks.
Check with Harshal regarding running similar campaigns.
Discuss and finalize the commercial agreement after the initial webinar week.
Plan and schedule the initial pilot webinar.
Share the script and additional information needed for the 50 gigs.
Send over SW document to the prospect.
Budget
Awaits webinar outcomes before approving additional costs.
Seeks evidence of webinar success to guide future financial decisions.
Budget of $5,000 for campaign
Discussing Facebook budgeting and other marketing strategies.
Budget allocation of "One k for paid management and 20 k for tourism media, all organic"
Decision Maker
Considering Harsha sent a PDF with commercials, it implies Harsha plays a role in decision-making.
Business Goals
Immediate focus on webinar marketing for lead generation and conversion.
Plan to create a WhatsApp group for better community engagement.
Goal of 1,000 paid customers leading to one crore in revenue
Abhishek highlighted the need to attract target customers such as Shopify owners and Amazon sellers through localized campaigns.
Interest in investing 10 lakh rupees
Emphasized the importance of social media, quality leads, ROI, and combining SEO with paid marketing.
Discussed the need to drive results quickly and actively work with the team.
Timeline
Discussed creating content and strategy for the first 10 days before the webinar.
Pricing
Webinar cost is 10,000 rupees plus GST
500 leads acquired at 99 rupees each
Positive Moment
The plan for the next week or 10 days, as included in the PPT, is well-documented and very well thought out.
Acknowledged the importance of having the right expertise to save and make money.
Pain Points
Spending 5,000 rupees for 50 leads
The issue of remaining problems persists despite having some solutions in place.
Prospect mentioned having bad experiences with agencies from Delhi and Pune in the last six months.
Impact
Prospect is the key decision-maker given their active involvement in discussing strategy, budget, and expectations.
